title: DeliveryProject
description: A registered project binding in the canonical multi-project delivery control plane. One row per project the orchestrator is allowed to route work to; unknown project ids are never inferred from ambient working-directory scope.

slug.description: Short, filesystem-safe, human-chosen project identifier used in worktree and lane paths.

revision.description: Optimistic-concurrency counter; incremented on every update.

metadata.description: Static repository facts: its configuration (package manager, layout, naming convention, test framework, linters, formatters) and the provider routing already resolved for it. Configuration is captured automatically when an agent's tool call touches a recognized config file (go.mod, package.json, a lockfile, .golangci.yml, etc.), or set explicitly via upsert_project. Each field is merged independently on write, never wholesale-replaced, so one detector's update never erases another's.

github_org.description: The configured GitHub organisation whose credential reaches this repository, remembered the first time it was resolved. A repository owner is not always an organisation id - a credential holds an account of whatever name its token belongs to - so this records which credential was proven to work rather than deriving it again. It is a local routing fact and never a credential.
